meta.note: The city past the play box from the NYC Open Data footprints (Manhattan, Long Island City, Brooklyn waterfront between 40.70 and 40.80 N) and OSM (New Jersey). boxes: [x, z, w, d, h, rot, cls], game units, rot = rotation.y (w along local X). cls 0 = one tax block of low fabric as a single mass (area-weighted height, shrunk to the built fraction), within 900 m of the box edge; cls 1 = a building of 40 m or more (its own rectangle and NYC roof height) anywhere in the data; cls 2 = New Jersey. named: the famous distant towers (index into boxes, true height). water: the Hudson and East River over the whole surround (+-1000 u) as {name, polygon, holes} (Roosevelt Island and the Hudson piers are holes = land), plus the lakes past the box (the Reservoir, the Lake...). palisades: the New Jersey cliff foot line. One WTC stands 5.5 km south of the box.

palisades.note: Polyline along the foot of the Palisades cliff (approximate to about 100 m); the bluff top is about 45-60 m up and the land rises to the west of the line (Union City, Weehawken Heights, West New York on top).
